description: JWE ECDH-ES+A256KW/A256GCM conformance vector with apu/apv party-info (RFC 7518 §4.6.2). Fixed inputs: recipient key 0x01..0x20, ephemeral key 0xa1..0xc0, CEK 0xC0..0xDF, zero IV, plaintext and party-info below — reproducible from the RFC 7518 pipeline in any language. Every implementation of the keys_jwe decrypt path MUST decrypt this JWE to exactly the plaintext (seam audit D2).
